summary: Gone ground-level site in Harford County, Maryland, whose name matches the Cardiff and Whiteford communities. No source gives its build date, staffing or fate.

evidence.quote: It encompasses portions of two communities in northern Harford County that were historically associated with slate production during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
